roles.title: The Harvester
roles.description: Pick donated fruit at partner vineyards each harvest — no experience necessary, just willing hands.
tasks: Pick and sort donated fruit at partner vineyards during harvest weekends
Work alongside other volunteers under the guidance of our vineyard partners
Help transport fruit from the vine to the partner cellar
perks: Gloves, buckets, and all harvesting tools
Snacks, water, and shade breaks throughout the day
A Femme Ferments harvest t-shirt for your first shift
roles.time: A few weekend mornings each September and October.

roles.title: The Storyteller
roles.description: Photograph the crush, write the newsletter, keep the community in the loop between vintages.
tasks: Photograph the harvest, crush, and community events
Write and edit our seasonal newsletter
Help manage our social media presence between vintages
perks: Access to past photo archives and brand guidelines
Editorial support and feedback on drafts
Credit for your work across our channels
roles.time: A few hours per month, on your own schedule.

roles.title: The Host
roles.description: Organize tastings and gatherings that introduce new people to what we're building.
tasks: Plan and coordinate tastings and community gatherings
Welcome new guests and introduce them to our mission
Coordinate logistics with venues and partner wineries
perks: Event templates, checklists, and a planning budget
A team of volunteers to help on event day
roles.time: Roughly one event every one to two months.

roles.title: The Builder
roles.description: Lend your skills — design, carpentry, logistics — to keep our operation running.
tasks: Lend design, carpentry, or logistics skills to active projects
Help maintain our tasting room and event spaces
Support behind-the-scenes operations however you're able
perks: Recognition for your contribution in our materials
roles.time: Project-based — as little or as much as you can give.

roles.title: The Connector
roles.description: Bridge the gap between Femme Ferments and your network of donors and allies.
tasks: Introduce Femme Ferments to potential donors and allies
Help build relationships with local businesses and press
Represent us at community and industry events
perks: Talking points, one-pagers, and a donor deck
Direct access to our founding team
Recognition as a founding community connector
roles.time: As opportunities arise — no fixed schedule.

roles.title: The Maker
roles.description: If you're a winemaker, your craft is the heart of every bottle we produce.
tasks: Guide the winemaking process from crush to bottle
Mentor volunteers during harvest and cellar work
Help shape the style and quality of every vintage
perks: Access to partner cellar space and equipment
A dedicated volunteer crew during key cellar work
Full creative input on blending and style decisions
roles.time: Seasonal — most intensive during harvest and crush.

vision.headline: Beauty Begins Where Things Break
vision.body: Femme Ferments began with a simple, stubborn idea: that wine — an industry long shaped by men's names on the label — could instead become a vessel for women's independence. We gather donated fruit, borrowed cellars, and volunteer hands to craft small-batch wines, and we funnel every dollar of profit back into programs that give women the resources to build something of their own.

valley.headline: The Land
valley.body: Willamette Valley's cool nights and volcanic soil have made it one of the great Pinot Noir regions on earth — but the vineyards and cellars here have opened their gates to us for another reason too. Partner growers set aside rows of fruit each harvest, and neighboring wineries lend us press time and tank space, because they believe the valley is big enough to grow both great wine and greater opportunity.
